player_prompt.intro:
Kd nkk s {player_id} g Connect Four.
Ayya n uslig: {symbol}.
Tablatt n urar tla {num_rows} tiswasin d {num_cols} tiswilin.
Inagan ttwarrun s wakud n uslig-nsen s yiwen seg tiswilin (0 ar {end_col}).
Wid izwarn ittɣimun (s uslig-nsen) kkuẓ n isligiyen s wadda, s ussaɣ, neɣ s tɣzi ttwaxdamen.
G wakud-ik, sekkel aswir n tiswit s tibratin icctanin akken ad tekkiḍ.
S umdya: '[col 4]' neɣ '[col 1]'.
